verdict.rationale: Steel describes itself as an open-source browser API, and a public GitHub repo (steel-dev/steel-browser) has readable code, Docker images and API features; a community commenter also notes it is open source. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named in the evidence, it is unclear which managed-cloud features (stealth, CAPTCHA solving, proxies) are in the open repo versus cloud-only, and no hands-on confirmation of the license terms.
